**FAIL — 2 blocking findings, 3 should-fix findings.** T06 aligns with P009 P-5 and BR01/06/07/09. The current implementation still fails the finish and merge acceptance criteria. This was a fresh independent Codex run on OpenAI, with `cross=false`.

### Blocking findings

1. **T-4/T-5 · A zero-exit security check can still put unrelated content into the sealed tree.** A synthetic `보안 검사` changed and staged `outside.txt`, then exited `0`. `finish` auto-committed the file in `목차 갱신`, issued a seal, and exited `0`. The ordinary `검사` control correctly exited `1`, left HEAD unchanged, and preserved the staged edit for review. The security check runs before the intermediate `git add -A`, so the later cleanliness guard sees a clean tree. [Security check](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1405) · [Intermediate commit](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1436) · [Repro](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/stage-security/repo.wt/P001/side-effect.sh)

2. **T-5 · A pre-FF refusal can still dirty main and block retry when the project ref equals HEAD.** With no worktree, I pointed the synthetic project ref at main’s clean `진행` commit. `merge --yes --commit <approved SHA>` correctly refused the state, but wrote an untracked `log.jsonl` without moving HEAD. After restoring the valid sealed ref, the same approved merge failed because main was dirty. The ordinary absent-worktree rejection passed when the refs differed. Ref equality is being used as evidence that FF occurred. [Failure logging](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1710) · [Repro and outputs](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/equal-head.json)

### Should fix

1. **T-5 · The focused suite is red because its Git adapter quotes the Korean fixture path.** The R23 test’s final assertion received `undefined` from `checkedTeamTarget` after removing the marker. Its adapter supplies default `ls-tree` output, which quotes the seal path. The actual CLI pins `core.quotepath=false` and rejected the stale seal in the paired Korean-path control. This is a test fixture mismatch with the CLI. [Failing assertion](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/test/team-metrics.test.ts:245) · [Seal path lookup](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-finish.ts:78) · [CLI Git adapter](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:64)
2. **T-5 · Post-FF recovery works, but the team recovery instruction is incomplete.** A synthetic commit hook refused bookkeeping after FF. The CLI restored `병합 대기`, left the index clean, and retained the failure event. The printed restart sequence then hit a `log.jsonl` rebase conflict. Preserving both histories, finishing again, and merging with the newly previewed SHA succeeded. The recovery message should include the team SHA approval step and account for the log conflict. [Recovery message](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/harness.ts:1595) · [Recovery transcript](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/followup.log)
3. **T-4 · Definition-change receipts still have no role or purpose binding.** I reproduced the historical finding through the source CLI. `finish` accepted the same generic `proof.json` as both `changeRef` and `reasonRef` for an existing `maker`. The receipts establish file presence and format. The linkage is still left to the person reading the retrospective. [Validation](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:182) · [Control result](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/verified.json)

### Criteria and evidence

| Criterion | Current result |
|---|---|
| **T-1 · Request measurement** | **Achieved in tested scope.** The focused suite passed the actual reply-ID chronology control, counting the valid reply and leaving the pre-request reply unconfirmed. Stage17 supplies the broader request controls. |
| **T-2 · Observations and coverage** | **Achieved in tested scope.** Focused coverage passed for declared totals, missing evidence, role attribution, and existing event semantics. |
| **T-3 · Comparison and baselines** | **Achieved in tested scope.** Focused comparison and legacy adapter tests passed. All three T01 baseline artifacts matched their tracked bytes. Stage17 supplies the broader comparison controls. |
| **T-4 · Retrospective and finish** | **Unmet.** Ignored, untracked retrospective and typed proof files each caused refusal with HEAD and original bytes unchanged and no seal. Legacy foreign files were preserved and legacy `--yes` worked. Adopted tracked and untracked collisions were rejected before any auto-commit. The security check’s staged output still entered the sealed tree. |
| **T-5 · Source CLI and acceptance** | **Unmet.** Missing, wrong, abbreviated, and previous finish SHAs were rejected. The exact previewed SHA merged successfully. Preview and rejected validation left the actual index byte-identical in the tested cases. The equal-ref pre-FF rejection still blocks retry, and the focused suite has one failure. |

I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` once on Node `v24.22.3`. **102 tests, 101 passed, 1 failed, 0 skipped.** The independent probes made **60 source CLI calls**, including 36 `finish` or `merge` calls. The initial ignored-file assertions expected exit `1`. The CLI correctly returned `2`, and I verified the original transcripts, HEADs, and retained bytes without rerunning those calls. I read both prior judgments and used stage17 for historical coverage. The target patch passed reverse-apply checks before and after with SHA-256 `31f71d9437898f1ba72793dfe4b2c20d0f56620b48272c1c1ec9cfbeacd71bea`. All writes were confined to owned temporary fixtures. [Focused log](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/focused.log) · [Commands and raw outputs](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/commands.jsonl) · [Probe](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/probe.py) · [Follow-up](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/followup.py) · [Final controls](/tmp/pace-t06-independent.U5yxjP/final-controls.py)

**Upper-goal status.** The measurement contract separates owner reach, reported workload, and quality, and supplies BR07 with retrospective input. T06 and T07 remain required. Real adoption, efficacy, and live retrospective use remain **unknown**, held for the user’s T08 validation after main merge and installation. `owner` denotes the current user and `--no-launch` records `runtimeObserved:false`. Metadata and the SHA bind recorded claims or content while providing no human authentication or protection from intentional same-account fabrication. The generic whole-document lone-CR limitation remains documented. The full suite remains with the PM.
